name: Figments
long_description:
Figments explored what happens when technology rewrites the rules of storytelling.
Over seven years we built narrative games, virtual influencers, AI characters, creative tools, and eventually Plotdrive, an AI writing engine for long form storytelling. Each product explored a different piece of how stories are imagined, created, and shared as technology transformed creative work.
one_liner: Building worlds at technological inflection points

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Former high-stakes poker pro turned company builder. Created one of the earliest poker training platforms, built VR games and AI worlds, now helping founders build what's next.

founders.title: Co-founder & Head of Product
founders.founder_bio: YC S19 founder with seven years of 0→1 experience at the intersection of product and GTM. I grew Plotdrive to hundreds of paying customers by leading customer research, positioning, onboarding, activation, and retention. Previously, I led GTM initiatives in gaming. I’m looking to bring that customer-centered product experience to an ambitious B2B or B2E team.
